title: A ShopCoach line reads Title - Description in the Customer Invoice report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Require Tech Story (Settings, Work Orders tab) is off.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A05 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A05 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Work-order-1} has a line {Line-1} added from the ShopCoach line builder, with no tech story, whose title {Title-A} (for example Inspect brakes) and description {Description-A} (for example Customer reports grinding) were written down when it was added.
  • {Work-order-1} has been completed and invoiced as invoice {Invoice-A} (for example 10234), dated {Invoice-date-A} (for example 13 Oct 2026).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports page and click Export Reports (if it is not there, open it from Administration).
  2. Choose the Customer Invoice report.
  3. Set the date range to cover {Invoice-date-A}.
  4. Download the report.
  5. Open the downloaded file in a spreadsheet (for example Google Sheets: File, Import, Upload).
  6. Find the row for {Line-1} on invoice {Invoice-A} and read its ItemDescription cell.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: a Customer Invoice file downloads.
  • Step 6: the cell reads exactly {Title-A}, a space, a hyphen, a space and {Description-A} (for example "Inspect brakes - Customer reports grinding"), with nothing after the description.
  • Step 6: the cell contains no "What are you doing?", no "Why are you doing it?", no "Tech Story:" and no semicolon added by the app.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10131 (Story 2, The ShopCoach Line Builder); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S2-R3, S3-R1, S3-R3, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (What reaches QuickBooks), 13 Oct copy; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R3: “What ShopCoach generates and writes into a line is unchanged. A generated line becomes an ordinary work order line and follows Story 3 like any other.”
  • S3-R3: “A separator appears only between two segments that are both present. A line with no description joins the title straight to the narrative. A line with no narrative ends after the description. A line with neither carries the title alone. In every case there is no trailing separator and no trailing space.”
  • SV-10131 acceptance criteria: “Given a line generated by ShopCoach reaches an invoice, then its line text follows Story 3 with no special handling.”
